answer: The ripple register is checked at draw time, ivory lists the eligible set, and island seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an adversary pays for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 5 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
